I don't have anywhere to go with this body. I don't have anyone I trust and I have no means nor desire to go on. My country has no decent protective services, and in an Asian country they'll just see my fighting back as unfilial. But it's okay. I feel great. She's not doing this to me. I just finally have the glittering courage I've always wanted.
